title: Digital Skills Essentials
description: A reusable SCORM 1.2 demonstration course covering six supported interaction types.
intro: Complete all six questions. Your progress is saved by the learning management system.

results.passed: Well done. You demonstrated a strong understanding of essential digital skills.
results.failed: Review the feedback and learning material before starting another Moodle attempt.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of cloud storage?

choices.text: To store and access files online

questions.correctFeedback: Correct. Cloud storage makes files available online from connected devices.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Cloud storage is primarily used to store and access files online.

questions.prompt: Put the steps for sending a professional email in the correct order.
questions.correctFeedback: Correct. Reviewing the message before sending helps prevent avoidable mistakes.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Check the recipient and subject before writing, then review before sending.

questions.prompt: Match each digital term with its meaning.

pairs.right: A secret used to protect an account
A software program for a device

questions.incorrectFeedback: Review the purpose of browsers, passwords, and apps.

questions.prompt: Which actions help keep online accounts secure?
questions.correctFeedback: Correct. Strong passwords and two-factor authentication improve account security.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Select every safe action and avoid sharing passwords or opening unknown links.

questions.prompt: Assign each action to the correct category.

items.text: Enter a password on a public computer

questions.correctFeedback: Correct. You identified the safer and unsafe behaviors.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Security updates and sender verification are safer; passwords and verification codes must remain private.
